# Scope

Sage has 1,770 active vendors, but most have no recorded activity. Activity is the latest of Sage last bill, Sage last payment and Ramp last spend.

| **Activity** | **In Ramp** | **Not in Ramp** | **Total** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Since 2024-10-26** | 478 | 85 | 563 |
| **Before 2024-10-26** | 8 | 292 | 300 |
| **None recorded** | 65 | 842 | 907 |
| **Total** | 551 | 1,219 | 1,770 |

| **Sage vendor type** | **Vendors** | **Never billed in Sage** |
|---|---|---|
| **Blank** | 922 | 565 |
| **Credit Cards** | 427 | 418 |
| **MinIO employee** | 136 | 62 |
| **AR reseller** | 127 | 125 |
| **1099 Vendor** | 88 | 17 |
| **Tax** | 28 | 15 |
| **Other types** | 42 | 18 |

The export of all active vendors lists 1,775. The 5 not in the detail export are flagged One-time use in Sage. The Sage vendor list report has 1,788: the 1,775 plus 13 inactive.

27 Ramp vendors have no Sage vendor, for example KPMG LLP, Baker Botts LLP, Oracle America and Navan.
